_about: Which players or teams count for a question. A group is a set of rows from one dataset chosen by plain rules, written so a player can predict them. The label finishes the sentence "X isn't ___" when someone names a real player or team outside the group. Templates take a season, so "hitters-2019" is the 2019 hitters group.

hof-hitters.label: a Hall of Fame hitter
hof-hitters.rule: Inducted into the Hall of Fame as a player, debuted in 1901 or later and played only in the American and National Leagues, with at least 2,000 career at-bats.

hof-pitchers.label: a Hall of Fame pitcher
hof-pitchers.rule: Inducted into the Hall of Fame as a player, debuted in 1901 or later and played only in the American and National Leagues, with at least 300 games pitched and fewer than 2,000 career at-bats.

hits-2000.label: a player with 2,000 or more career hits
hits-2000.rule: Debuted in 1901 or later, played only in the American and National Leagues, and has at least 2,000 career hits.

wins-150.label: a pitcher with 150 or more career wins
wins-150.rule: Debuted in 1901 or later, played only in the American and National Leagues, and has at least 150 career pitching wins.

templates.label: a {year} hitter with 200 or more at-bats
templates.rule: Had at least 200 at-bats in the {year} regular season.

templates.label: a {year} pitcher with 50 or more innings
templates.rule: Pitched at least 50 innings in the {year} regular season.

templates.label: a {year} MLB team
templates.rule: Every team that played the {year} regular season.
